name: MeterCell
description: A responsive table meter: the reading remains when the narrow cell drops its track.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name when there is no visible label.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes applied to the outer element for layout. Use the component props and theme tokens for its appearance.

props.name: dangerAt
props.description: Threshold at which the value enters the danger state.

props.name: description
props.description: Full tooltip breakdown; defaults to the visible reading.

props.name: max
props.description: Upper value or visible-item limit, as specified by the type.

props.name: value
props.description: The controlled value. Keep it in application state and update it in the change callback.

props.name: valueText
props.description: The reading, with units: "212 GB of 256 GB". Defaults to the percentage.

props.name: warningAt
props.description: Fraction of max where the bar turns warning (default 0.75) and danger (0.9).
